intro.text: A planet hit by the dark aether, a force that made it unsafe for aetherbound to remain there.

description.text: Followers of the aethers hold that the aethers gave humans rebirth so they could encourage and lift up one another. At death a person goes back to the aethers to reflect on their life, and those who chose badly must wait long to be reborn. A common oath is "by the first aether".
Its people worship the aethers as gods older than the Shattering and even than Adonalsium, and believe the aethers made every person to think differently.
Dhatri has at least twelve kingdoms. Among its offices is that of Raj, and it has a body called the Coriander Court.

Some Dhatrians have black hair, at times braided, and brown skin with a light tan undertone, and many favor bright, colorful clothes. The planet has its own flowing script, and owning a dead aether is thought very bad luck.

items.text: Travel to Dhatri became very costly. The planet sells aethers, but they are expensive and tightly regulated.
